meta.definition: t_int(eps;n)=tau_R * ∫_{z_src}^{z_dst} exp(-(A(z)+eps*Phi_n(z))) dz (discrete trapz on frozen grid)
meta.Phi_n_normalization: Phi_n(z) is normalized so max(|Phi_n|)=1 on the spectrum grid, then linearly interpolated onto the integration grid
meta.A_source: A(z) sampled from the frozen background and linearly interpolated onto the integration grid
